head: Apple Watch voice recorder app Tapkeep turns your day into text
dek: Tapkeep records your day from an Apple Watch with one tap, then turns the audio into text on your iPhone, split into titled conversations you can search. It costs $9.99 once with no subscription, and was #86 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 24 November.
details: You can search by word, meaning or person, ask questions about a day or a week, and get daily, weekly and monthly journals; the AI journal and questions have usage limits unless you add your own key for a service such as OpenAI or DeepSeek. For transcription the audio goes to the developer's service and isn't kept, the listing says; an on-device option is in Settings, and text sent to an AI service (named as DeepSeek) is only sent if you agree. Recording on the watch needs a Series 6, SE (2nd generation), Ultra or newer with watchOS 11, paired with an iPhone on iOS 18. Made by Wuxi Huaxiaoman Technology, it came out on 14 November.
where: Apple Watch and iPhone, App Store, $9.99 one-time
means: If you forget what was said in meetings or chats, this keeps a searchable written record. It also records the people around you, so think about who is in the room.
todo: Check your watch model and iOS version first. If you'd rather keep audio on your phone, turn on on-device transcription in the app's Settings.
thumb_words: APPLE WATCH RECORDS YOUR WHOLE DAY
